tasks.goal: Stop the tower crane's mast standing through a grown lot's room: add craneBase(p) to src/sim/interior.js and make raiseCrane in src/render/zoning.js stand the mast on it.
tasks.commit: fix(interiors): a climbing crane stands on the ground floor's ceiling, not through the room
tasks.notes: craneBase(p) returns 0 below STAGE.LOW and the room's ceiling height (PARCEL_FLOOR plus the 3.0 room height parcelSpace uses; name that 3.0 as a constant and use it in both places) from LOW up. In raiseCrane, the mast box starts at craneBase(p) instead of 0 and keeps its top where it is now, so its height becomes mastTop - base. Import craneBase into src/render/zoning.js from ../sim/interior.js. Nothing else of the crane moves.

tasks.goal: Rearrange the fixtures parcelItems puts in a grown room in src/sim/interior.js so the player never arrives inside furniture and the follow cam always has room behind them.
tasks.commit: fix(interiors): fixtures clear the arrival and the camera behind it
tasks.notes: The failures are the residential stair core: in a narrow room it covers the arrival spot, and near the front it blocks the camera when the player turns. One way that works on every room: put the stair at the back of the room, d from max(d0 + 3.2, d1 - 3.2) to d1 - 0.5, and leave it out when the room is narrower than a1 >= 2.3 or that range is under 1.0 m. Do not move the arrival or change the camera code; fix the furniture. tests/interior.spec.js must stay green.
